## BUG — blocking state

```text
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/workspace/scratch/10a971b52076/DRG-Simulation/audit/run_01_recorder.py", line 298, in main
    sim.run()
  File "/workspace/scratch/10a971b52076/DRG-Simulation/engine/simulate.py", line 1251, in run
    self.run_round()
  File "/workspace/scratch/10a971b52076/DRG-Simulation/engine/simulate.py", line 1242, in run_round
    self.turn(runner, scripts.get(runner['player_id']))
  File "/workspace/scratch/10a971b52076/DRG-Simulation/engine/simulate.py", line 1078, in turn
    used_plays = self.resolve_treat_prepare(runner, plan)
                 ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/workspace/scratch/10a971b52076/DRG-Simulation/engine/simulate.py", line 686, in resolve_treat_prepare
    raise ValueError('Fuel unavailable')
ValueError: Fuel unavailable
```

**Cause at the stopping decision:** P1 began round 3 at mile 1.75, Race Pace,
13 Energy, unspent Will, and Pack `PACK-R3-1` with P3. After Replenish, P1
held `FU-019` Salt Tabs and had Cramp (CO-002, Effective Severity 4),
Stomach Trouble (CO-013, Effective Severity 5), and newly drawn Nausea
(CO-012, Effective Severity 4). The deterministic Treat/Prepare chooser
selected Salt Tabs as a named Cramp remedy. Canonical Stomach Trouble makes
Fuel unavailable while its Effective Severity is positive. `use_fuel()`
correctly rejected the play, but `resolve_treat_prepare()` raised instead of
allowing a different legal choice. This is an AI legality/turn-path **BUG**;
no card, Pace Energy, Will, or Movement was committed on P1's third turn.
The race cannot continue through the unchanged deterministic AI policy, so
the run stopped without a patch or second seed.
